cards.question: Why has concurrency become more popular on modern CPUs?
cards.answer: The number of cores and threads per core has increased.

cards.question: What role does concurrency play when resources are limited?
cards.answer: It is the only way to improve performance with limited resources.

cards.question: Where is concurrency widely used?
cards.answer: In modern computing systems, operating systems, and large distributed clusters.

cards.question: Besides performance, what does concurrency help developers do?
cards.answer: It helps model the real world, maximises system efficiency from users’ and developers’ perspectives, and lets developers solve large, complex problems.
